import re
user_texts=[]
for m in msgs:
 if m.get('role')=='user':
  cont=m.get('content',[])
  user_texts.append(''.join(c.get('text','') for c in cont if c.get('type')=='text') if isinstance(cont,list) else str(cont))
demos=[]
for t in user_texts:
 for match in re.finditer(r'Demo pair \d+ input \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n', t):
  h,w=map(int,match.groups()); start=match.end(); section=t[start:]
  rows=section.split('Demo pair')[0].split('Same instance')[0].strip().splitlines()[:h]
  inp=[[int(x) for x in row.split()] for row in rows]
  om=re.search(rf'Demo pair \d+ output \({h}x{w}\):\n', section)
  if not om: continue
  outrows=section[om.end():].split('Same instance')[0].strip().splitlines()[:h]
  outg=[[int(x) for x in row.split()] for row in outrows]
  demos.append((inp,outg))
print(len(demos), [(len(a),len(a[0]),len(b),len(b[0])) for a,b in demos])

program='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    counts = Counter(cell for row in grid for cell in row)
    if len(counts) < 2:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    # The common background takes the rare foreground color; the rare pixels vanish.
    background, foreground = counts.most_common(2)[0][0], counts.most_common(2)[1][0]
    return [[foreground if cell == background else 0 if cell == foreground else cell for cell in row] for row in grid]
'''
p.write_text(program)
ns={}; exec(p.read_text(),ns)
checks=[ns['transform'](a)==b for a,b in demos]
print('demo checks',checks,'test counts',Counter(x for r in grid for x in r))
out=ns['transform'](grid)
print(len(out),len(out[0]),out[0],out[-1])
